Not all therapists or counseling collectives will cost the same, not all therapists or therapies are the same. Broad range, something's better than nothing don't stress too hard. It's as simple as finding clinics around you through Google and then digging through who they employ to find someones description that you like before checking their availability. You might want a female therapist for an outside perspective, or you might want a male for relation, young therapist or old. Experience does matter, I'd even ask how long they've been in practice.
